name: SegFormer Light
short_description: Default PyTorch model for online MEYELens recordings.
description: A lightweight SegFormer model for eye and pupil segmentation from eye-facing camera frames. This is the default MEYELens PyTorch model and is recommended for online recordings, where a good balance between segmentation quality and inference speed is needed.

specs.Recommended use: Online recordings and general MEYELens pupillometry workflows
specs.Performance: Optimized for practical online inference; exact frame rate depends on hardware

other_details.Notes: Recommended default model for online recordings. Use a GPU for higher frame rates; CPU execution is supported but may run at a lower frame rate.

name: SegFormer Medium
short_description: Higher-capacity PyTorch model for MEYELens eye and pupil segmentation.
description: A medium-size SegFormer model for eye and pupil segmentation from eye-facing camera frames. This model provides a higher-capacity alternative to the default SegFormer Light model and is useful when segmentation quality is prioritized over inference speed.

specs.Recommended use: Online experiments (with GPU acceleration). Offline analysis and recordings where higher segmentation capacity is preferred
specs.Performance: Higher-capacity model; inference speed depends on hardware and may be slower than SegFormer Light

other_details.Notes: Use this model when segmentation robustness is more important than maximum online frame rate. GPU acceleration is recommended.

name: EfficientFormerV2 Light
short_description: Fast and lightweight PyTorch model for MEYELens eye and pupil segmentation.
description: A lightweight EfficientFormerV2 model for eye and pupil segmentation from eye-facing camera frames. This model is designed for fast inference and is suitable for online recordings, CPU-based workflows, and lower-resource systems where inference speed is important.

specs.Recommended use: Online recordings, CPU workflows, embedded systems, and lower-resource devices
specs.Performance: Lightweight model optimized for fast inference; exact frame rate depends on hardware

other_details.Notes: Use this model when inference speed and low computational cost are priorities. It may be useful on smaller or dedicated devices where heavier models are less practical.

name: EfficientFormerV2 Small
short_description: Compact PyTorch model for MEYELens eye and pupil segmentation.
description: A compact EfficientFormerV2 model for eye and pupil segmentation from eye-facing camera frames. This model provides a practical balance between inference speed and segmentation capacity, making it suitable for general MEYELens workflows.

specs.Recommended use: General online and offline MEYELens pupillometry workflows
specs.Performance: Compact model with balanced inference speed and segmentation capacity; exact frame rate depends on hardware

other_details.Notes: Use this model when you need a compact EfficientFormerV2 alternative with more capacity than the light version while keeping inference practical.

name: EfficientFormerV2 Medium
short_description: Balanced PyTorch model for MEYELens eye and pupil segmentation.
description: A medium-size EfficientFormerV2 model for eye and pupil segmentation from eye-facing camera frames. This model provides a stronger segmentation capacity than the light and small EfficientFormerV2 versions, while remaining practical for MEYELens online and offline workflows.

specs.Recommended use: Online and offline MEYELens workflows where a balance between segmentation capacity and inference speed is needed
specs.Performance: Medium-capacity model with balanced segmentation performance and inference speed; exact frame rate depends on hardware

other_details.Notes: Use this model when you want more segmentation capacity than the light or small EfficientFormerV2 versions, while keeping inference more practical than a large model.

name: EfficientFormerV2 Large
short_description: High-capacity PyTorch model for MEYELens eye and pupil segmentation.
description: A large EfficientFormerV2 model for eye and pupil segmentation from eye-facing camera frames. This model provides the highest-capacity EfficientFormerV2 option in the MEYELens model zoo and is useful when segmentation quality is prioritized over inference speed.

specs.Recommended use: Offline analysis, validation workflows, and recordings where maximum EfficientFormerV2 segmentation capacity is preferred
specs.Performance: High-capacity model; inference speed depends on hardware and may be slower than the light, small, and medium EfficientFormerV2 versions

other_details.Notes: Use this model when segmentation robustness is more important than maximum online frame rate. GPU acceleration is recommended.

name: MEYE pupil segmentation
short_description: (Deprecated) Default pupil mask and blink classification.
description: A model for interspecies pupil segmentation, blink classification, and extraction of frame-level pupil measurements from eye-facing camera recordings.

specs.Task: Pupil segmentation and eye/blink classification in mice and humans
specs.Output: Pupil mask, eye probability, blink probability
specs.Performance: >20 fps or higher with GPU support

other_details.Validated paradigms: PLR, pupil frequency tagging, auditory oddball, commercial eye-tracker comparison
